items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 103:1
items.html: (To the question) Because after her receiving the Mochin of the separation from ZA, she has in those Mochin two sweetenings: one from Ima herself, namely from the time she was in the Hall of Aba and Ima, in the aspect of MAN; and the second, by means of ZA, who gives them to her a second time, in the manner of the degree. (Item 124).
